mariadb.obtener_tablas: SELECT CONVERT(table_name USING utf8mb4) AS table_name, CONVERT(table_comment USING utf8mb4) AS table_comment, SUBSTRING_INDEX(TABLE_COLLATION, '_', 1) AS charset, TABLE_COLLATION AS collation FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = '{database}' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY table_name
mariadb.obtener_vistas: SELECT CONVERT(table_name USING utf8mb4) AS table_name, CONVERT(table_comment USING utf8mb4) AS table_comment FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = '{database}' AND table_type = 'VIEW' ORDER BY table_name
mariadb.columnas_tabla: SELECT CONVERT(column_name USING utf8mb4) AS column_name, CONVERT(column_type USING utf8mb4) AS column_type, is_nullable, column_key, CAST(column_default AS CHAR(100)) AS column_default, CONVERT(extra USING utf8mb4) AS extra, CONVERT(column_comment USING utf8mb4) AS column_comment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = '{database}' AND table_name = '{tabla}' ORDER BY ordinal_position
mariadb.indices: SELECT CONVERT(INDEX_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS INDEX_NAME, CONVERT(COLUMN_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS COLUMN_NAME, NON_UNIQUE, CONVERT(INDEX_TYPE USING utf8mb4) AS INDEX_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY INDEX_NAME, SEQ_IN_INDEX
mariadb.claves_primarias: SELECT CONVERT(COLUMN_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
mariadb.claves_foraneas: SELECT CONVERT(CONSTRAINT_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS CONSTRAINT_NAME, CONVERT(TABLE_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS TABLE_NAME, CONVERT(COLUMN_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS COLUMN_NAME, CONVERT(REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME, CONVERT(REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
mariadb.claves_unicas: SELECT CONVERT(CONSTRAINT_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS CONSTRAINT_NAME, CONVERT(COLUMN_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME != 'PRIMARY' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME NOT LIKE 'FK_%' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
mariadb.obtener_rutinas: SELECT CONVERT(routine_name USING utf8mb4) AS routine_name, UPPER(CONVERT(routine_type USING utf8mb4)) AS routine_type, CONVERT(COALESCE(routine_comment, '') USING utf8mb4) AS routine_comment FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = '{database}' ORDER BY routine_type, routine_name
mariadb.parametros_rutina: SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(p.routine_type) = 'FUNCTION' AND p.ordinal_position = 0 THEN 'RETURN' ELSE COALESCE(CONVERT(p.parameter_mode USING utf8mb4), '') END AS parameter_mode, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.routine_type) = 'FUNCTION' AND p.ordinal_position = 0 THEN 'RETURN_VALUE' ELSE COALESCE(CONVERT(p.parameter_name USING utf8mb4), '') END AS parameter_name, COALESCE(CONVERT(p.dtd_identifier USING utf8mb4), '') AS data_type, '' AS parameter_default, p.ordinal_position FROM information_schema.parameters p WHERE p.specific_schema = '{database}' AND UPPER(p.specific_name) = UPPER('{rutina}') AND UPPER(p.routine_type) = UPPER('{tipo_rutina}') ORDER BY p.ordinal_position
mariadb.ficheros_fisicos: SELECT CONVERT(t.table_schema USING utf8mb4) AS db, CONVERT(t.table_name USING utf8mb4) AS objeto, CONVERT(t.engine USING utf8mb4) AS motor, ROUND(t.data_length/1024/1024, 2) AS datos_mb, ROUND(t.index_length/1024/1024, 2) AS indices_mb, ROUND((t.data_length+t.index_length)/1024/1024, 2) AS total_mb FROM information_schema.tables t WHERE t.table_schema = '{database}' ORDER BY total_mb DESC
mariadb.database_version: SELECT CONVERT(VERSION() USING utf8mb4) AS version
mariadb.database_charset_collation: SELECT CONVERT(DEFAULT_CHARACTER_SET_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS charset, CONVERT(DEFAULT_COLLATION_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS collation FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = '{database}'
mariadb.columns_charset_collation: SELECT CONVERT(COLUMN_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS column_name, CONVERT(CHARACTER_SET_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS charset, CONVERT(COLLATION_NAME USING utf8mb4) AS collation FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = '{database}' AND table_name = '{tabla}' AND (CHARACTER_SET_NAME IS NOT NULL OR COLLATION_NAME IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

oracle.obtener_tablas: SELECT t.table_name, c.comments AS table_comment FROM all_tables t LEFT JOIN all_tab_comments c ON t.owner = c.owner AND t.table_name = c.table_name WHERE t.owner = '{database}' ORDER BY t.table_name
oracle.obtener_vistas: SELECT v.view_name AS table_name, c.comments AS table_comment FROM all_views v LEFT JOIN all_mview_comments c ON v.owner = c.owner AND v.view_name = c.mview_name WHERE v.owner = '{database}' ORDER BY v.view_name
oracle.create_table: SELECT DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL('TABLE', '{tabla}', '{esquema}') AS DDL FROM DUAL
oracle.create_view: SELECT DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL('VIEW', '{tabla}', '{esquema}') AS DDL FROM DUAL
oracle.columnas_tabla: SELECT c.column_name, c.data_type, CASE WHEN c.nullable = 'Y' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS nullable_flag, c.data_default, c.data_length, c.data_precision, c.data_scale, com.comments AS column_comment FROM all_tab_columns c LEFT JOIN all_col_comments com ON c.owner = com.owner AND c.table_name = com.table_name AND c.column_name = com.column_name WHERE c.owner = '{database}' AND c.table_name = '{tabla}' ORDER BY c.column_id
oracle.indices: SELECT idx.index_name, idx.uniqueness, idx.index_type, col.column_name, col.column_position FROM all_indexes idx JOIN all_ind_columns col ON idx.index_name = col.index_name AND idx.table_owner = col.table_owner WHERE idx.table_name = UPPER('{tabla}') AND idx.table_owner = UPPER('{esquema}') ORDER BY idx.index_name, col.column_position
oracle.claves_primarias: SELECT cols.column_name FROM all_constraints cons, all_cons_columns cols WHERE cons.constraint_type = 'P' AND cons.constraint_name = cols.constraint_name AND cons.owner = cols.owner AND cols.table_name = '{tabla}' AND cols.owner = '{esquema}'
oracle.claves_foraneas: SELECT fk.constraint_name AS foreign_key_name, fk.column_name AS child_column_name, pk.table_name AS parent_table_name, pk.column_name AS parent_column_name FROM all_constraints fc JOIN all_cons_columns fk ON fk.owner = fc.owner AND fk.constraint_name = fc.constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pk ON pk.owner = fc.r_owner AND pk.constraint_name = fc.r_constraint_name AND pk.position = fk.position WHERE fc.constraint_type = 'R' AND fc.owner = UPPER('{esquema}') AND fc.table_name = UPPER('{tabla}') ORDER BY fk.constraint_name, fk.position
oracle.claves_unicas: SELECT a.constraint_name, a.column_name FROM all_cons_columns a JOIN all_constraints c ON a.owner = c.owner AND a.constraint_name = c.constraint_name WHERE c.constraint_type = 'U' AND a.table_name = '{tabla}' AND a.owner = '{esquema}' ORDER BY a.constraint_name, a.position
oracle.obtener_rutinas: SELECT CASE WHEN p.object_type = 'PACKAGE' AND p.procedure_name IS NOT NULL THEN p.object_name || '.' || p.procedure_name || CASE WHEN p.overload IS NOT NULL THEN '#' || p.overload ELSE '' END ELSE p.object_name END AS routine_name, CASE WHEN p.object_type = 'FUNCTION' THEN 'FUNCTION' WHEN p.object_type = 'PROCEDURE' THEN 'PROCEDURE' WHEN p.object_type = 'PACKAGE' AND p.procedure_name IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_arguments a WHERE a.owner = p.owner AND a.package_name = p.object_name AND a.object_name = p.procedure_name AND a.position = 0 AND NVL(a.overload, '0') = NVL(p.overload, '0')) THEN 'FUNCTION' WHEN p.object_type = 'PACKAGE' AND p.procedure_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'PROCEDURE' END AS routine_type, '' AS routine_comment FROM all_procedures p WHERE p.owner = '{database}' AND (p.object_type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION') OR (p.object_type = 'PACKAGE' AND p.procedure_name IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY routine_type, routine_name
oracle.parametros_rutina: SELECT COALESCE(a.in_out, '') AS parameter_mode, COALESCE(a.argument_name, '') AS parameter_name, COALESCE(a.data_type, '') AS data_type, CASE WHEN a.defaulted = 'Y' THEN 'YES' ELSE '' END AS parameter_default, a.position AS ordinal_position FROM all_arguments a WHERE a.owner = '{database}' AND UPPER(a.object_name) = UPPER('{rutina}') AND a.package_name IS NULL AND a.data_level = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_objects o WHERE o.owner = a.owner AND o.object_name = a.object_name AND o.object_type = UPPER('{tipo_rutina}')) ORDER BY a.position
oracle.create_rutina: SELECT DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL('{tipo_rutina}', '{rutina}', '{esquema}') AS DDL FROM DUAL
oracle.ficheros_fisicos: SELECT tablespace_name AS tablespace, file_name AS archivo, bytes/1024/1024 AS tamano_mb, status AS estado, 'DATAFILE' AS file_type, autoextensible AS autoextensible, maxbytes/1024/1024 AS max_mb FROM dba_data_files WHERE tablespace_name = UPPER('{tablespace}') ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC
oracle.temp_tablespaces: SELECT tablespace_name AS tablespace, file_name AS archivo, bytes/1024/1024 AS tamano_mb, status AS estado, 'TEMPFILE' AS file_type, autoextensible AS autoextensible, maxbytes/1024/1024 AS max_mb FROM dba_temp_files WHERE tablespace_name = UPPER('{tablespace}') ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC
oracle.database_version: SELECT BANNER AS version FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM = 1
oracle.database_charset_collation: SELECT PARAMETER AS parameter, VALUE AS value FROM nls_database_parameters WHERE PARAMETER IN ('NLS_CHARACTERSET', 'NLS_NCHAR_CHARACTERSET')
oracle.columns_charset_collation: SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS column_name, NULL AS charset, NULL AS collation FROM dual WHERE 1=0

postgresql.obtener_tablas: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, COALESCE(obj_description(c.oid), '') AS table_comment FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = '{database}' AND c.relkind = 'r' ORDER BY c.relname
postgresql.obtener_vistas: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, COALESCE(obj_description(c.oid), '') AS table_comment FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = '{database}' AND c.relkind = 'v' ORDER BY c.relname
postgresql.create_table:
SELECT 'CREATE TABLE ' || quote_ident(n.nspname) || '.' || quote_ident(c.relname) || E' (
' || string_agg('    ' || quote_ident(a.attname) || ' ' || format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) || CASE WHEN a.attnotnull THEN ' NOT NULL' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN ad.adbin IS NOT NULL THEN ' DEFAULT ' || pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid) ELSE '' END, E',
' ORDER BY a.attnum) || E'
);' AS ddl FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid = a.attrelid AND ad.adnum = a.attnum WHERE n.nspname = '{database}' AND c.relname = '{tabla}' AND c.relkind = 'r' GROUP BY n.nspname, c.relname
postgresql.columnas_tabla: SELECT c.column_name, c.data_type, CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 'YES' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_nullable, CASE WHEN c.column_default LIKE 'nextval%' THEN NULL ELSE c.column_default END AS column_default, c.character_maximum_length, c.numeric_precision, c.numeric_scale, COALESCE(pgd.description, '') AS column_comment FROM information_schema.columns c LEFT JOIN pg_class pgc ON pgc.relname = c.table_name LEFT JOIN pg_namespace pgn ON pgn.oid = pgc.relnamespace AND pgn.nspname = c.table_schema LEFT JOIN pg_description pgd ON pgd.objoid = pgc.oid AND pgd.objsubid = c.ordinal_position WHERE c.table_schema = '{database}' AND c.table_name = '{tabla}' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position
postgresql.indices: SELECT i.relname AS index_name, a.attname AS column_name, CASE WHEN idx.indisunique THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness, am.amname AS index_type FROM pg_index idx JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = idx.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = idx.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam JOIN LATERAL unnest(idx.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ordinality) ON TRUE JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE n.nspname = '{database}' AND t.relname = '{tabla}' ORDER BY i.relname, k.ordinality
postgresql.claves_primarias: SELECT kcu.column_name FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND tc.table_schema = '{database}' AND tc.table_name = '{tabla}' ORDER BY kcu.ordinal_position
postgresql.claves_foraneas: SELECT tc.constraint_name, kcu.column_name, ccu.table_name AS referenced_table, ccu.column_name AS referenced_column FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name AND ccu.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY' AND tc.table_schema = '{database}' AND tc.table_name = '{tabla}' ORDER BY tc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position
postgresql.claves_unicas: SELECT tc.constraint_name, kcu.column_name FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'UNIQUE' AND tc.table_schema = '{database}' AND tc.table_name = '{tabla}' ORDER BY tc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position
postgresql.obtener_rutinas: SELECT p.proname AS routine_name, CASE WHEN p.prokind = 'p' THEN 'PROCEDURE' ELSE 'FUNCTION' END AS routine_type, COALESCE(obj_description(p.oid), '') AS routine_comment FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = '{database}' AND p.prokind IN ('p', 'f', 'a', 'w') ORDER BY routine_type, p.proname
postgresql.parametros_rutina: SELECT COALESCE(p.parameter_mode, '') AS parameter_mode, COALESCE(p.parameter_name, '') AS parameter_name, COALESCE(p.data_type, '') AS data_type, COALESCE(p.parameter_default, '') AS parameter_default, p.ordinal_position FROM information_schema.parameters p JOIN information_schema.routines r ON r.specific_schema = p.specific_schema AND r.specific_name = p.specific_name WHERE p.specific_schema = '{database}' AND r.routine_name = '{rutina}' AND UPPER(r.routine_type) = '{tipo_rutina}' ORDER BY p.ordinal_position
postgresql.create_rutina: SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS ddl FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = '{esquema}' AND p.proname = '{rutina}' AND ((UPPER('{tipo_rutina}') = 'PROCEDURE' AND p.prokind = 'p') OR (UPPER('{tipo_rutina}') = 'FUNCTION' AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'a', 'w'))) ORDER BY p.oid LIMIT 1
postgresql.ficheros_fisicos: SELECT spcname AS tablespace, pg_tablespace_location(oid) AS filesystem_path, pg_size_pretty(pg_tablespace_size(oid)) AS total_size FROM pg_tablespace WHERE spcname = '{tablespace}'
postgresql.database_charset_collation: SELECT encoding::text AS encoding, datcollate, datctype FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()
postgresql.columns_charset_collation: SELECT a.attname AS column_name, NULL AS charset, coll.collname AS collation FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_collation coll ON a.attcollation = coll.oid WHERE a.attrelid = to_regclass(quote_ident('{database}') || '.' || quote_ident('{tabla}')) AND a.attnum > 0 AND a.attcollation != 0 ORDER BY a.attnum

hsqldb.obtener_tablas: SELECT TABLE_NAME, REMARKS AS table_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
hsqldb.obtener_vistas: SELECT TABLE_NAME, REMARKS AS table_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_TYPE = 'VIEW' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
hsqldb.create_table: SELECT TEXT AS ddl FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' UNION SELECT 'CREATE TABLE ' || TABLE_NAME || ' (' || LISTAGG(COLUMN_NAME || ' ' || DATA_TYPE || CASE WHEN CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH || ')' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN IS_NULLABLE = 'NO' THEN ' NOT NULL' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COLUMN_DEFAULT IS NOT NULL THEN ' DEFAULT ' || COLUMN_DEFAULT ELSE '' END, ', ') || ')' FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' GROUP BY TABLE_NAME
hsqldb.create_view: SELECT TEXT AS ddl FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}'
hsqldb.columnas_tabla: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_DEFAULT, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, REMARKS AS column_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
hsqldb.indices: SELECT INDEX_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, CASE WHEN NON_UNIQUE = 0 THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness, INDEX_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY INDEX_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
hsqldb.claves_primarias: SELECT kcu.COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA AND tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND tc.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' AND tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' ORDER BY kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION
hsqldb.claves_foraneas: SELECT rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, fk.COLUMN_NAME, pk.TABLE_NAME AS referenced_table, pk.COLUMN_NAME AS referenced_column FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE fk ON rc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = fk.TABLE_SCHEMA AND rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = fk.CONSTRAINT_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE pk ON rc.UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = pk.TABLE_SCHEMA AND rc.UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME = pk.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND fk.ORDINAL_POSITION = pk.ORDINAL_POSITION WHERE rc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND fk.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, fk.ORDINAL_POSITION
hsqldb.claves_unicas: SELECT tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, kcu.COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA AND tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND tc.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' AND tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' ORDER BY tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION
hsqldb.obtener_rutinas: SELECT ROUTINE_NAME AS routine_name, UPPER(ROUTINE_TYPE) AS routine_type, '' AS routine_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA = '{database}' ORDER BY ROUTINE_TYPE, ROUTINE_NAME
hsqldb.parametros_rutina: SELECT COALESCE(p.PARAMETER_MODE, '') AS parameter_mode, COALESCE(p.PARAMETER_NAME, '') AS parameter_name, COALESCE(p.DTD_IDENTIFIER, '') AS data_type, '' AS parameter_default, p.ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS p JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES r ON r.SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = p.SPECIFIC_SCHEMA AND r.SPECIFIC_NAME = p.SPECIFIC_NAME WHERE p.SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND r.ROUTINE_NAME = '{rutina}' AND UPPER(r.ROUTINE_TYPE) = UPPER('{tipo_rutina}') ORDER BY p.ORDINAL_POSITION
hsqldb.create_rutina: SELECT ROUTINE_DEFINITION AS ddl FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA = '{esquema}' AND ROUTINE_NAME = '{rutina}' AND UPPER(ROUTINE_TYPE) = UPPER('{tipo_rutina}')
hsqldb.database_version: SELECT IMPLEMENTATION_TITLE || ' ' || IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION AS version FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VERSION_FUNCTIONS
hsqldb.database_charset_collation: SELECT CASE WHEN T.COLLATION_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN T.COLLATION_NAME ELSE 'DEFAULT' END AS collation FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA S LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLLATIONS T ON S.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_SET_SCHEMA = T.CHARACTER_SET_CATALOG AND S.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_SET_NAME = T.CHARACTER_SET_NAME WHERE S.SCHEMA_NAME = '{database}'
hsqldb.columns_charset_collation: SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS column_name, NULL AS charset, COLLATION_NAME AS collation FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' AND COLLATION_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

sqlserver.obtener_tablas: SELECT t.TABLE_NAME, ISNULL(CAST(p.value AS VARCHAR(100)), '') AS table_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t LEFT JOIN sys.tables st ON st.name = t.TABLE_NAME LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties p ON p.major_id = st.object_id AND p.minor_id = 0 AND p.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND t.TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY t.TABLE_NAME
sqlserver.obtener_vistas: SELECT v.name AS TABLE_NAME, ISNULL(CAST(ep.value AS VARCHAR(100)), '') AS table_comment FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = v.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.major_id = v.object_id AND ep.minor_id = 0 AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE s.name = '{database}' ORDER BY v.name

('datetime2','time','datetimeoffset') THEN '(' + CAST(c.scale AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN ic.seed_value IS NOT NULL THEN ' IDENTITY(' + CAST(CAST(ic.seed_value AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR(30)) + ',' + CAST(CAST(ic.increment_value AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR(30)) + ')' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN dc.definition IS NOT NULL THEN ' DEFAULT ' + dc.definition ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 1 THEN ' NULL' ELSE ' NOT NULL' END FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON c.user_type_id = ty.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.identity_columns ic ON ic.object_id = c.object_id AND ic.column_id = c.column_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id = c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id = c.column_id WHERE c.object_id = t.object_id ORDER BY c.column_id FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') + ISNULL((SELECT ', CONSTRAINT [' + kc.name + '] PRIMARY KEY ' + CASE WHEN i.type = 1 THEN 'CLUSTERED' ELSE 'NONCLUSTERED' END + ' (' + STUFF((SELECT ', [' + cpk.name + ']' + CASE WHEN icpk.is_descending_key = 1 THEN ' DESC' ELSE ' ASC' END FROM sys.index_columns icpk JOIN sys.columns cpk ON cpk.object_id = icpk.object_id AND cpk.column_id = icpk.column_id WHERE icpk.object_id = kc.parent_object_id AND icpk.index_id = kc.unique_index_id AND icpk.key_ordinal > 0 ORDER BY icpk.key_ordinal FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') + ')' FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id = kc.parent_object_id AND i.index_id = kc.unique_index_id WHERE kc.parent_object_id = t.object_id AND kc.type = 'PK'), '') + ISNULL((SELECT STUFF((SELECT ', CONSTRAINT [' + fk.name + '] FOREIGN KEY (' + STUFF((SELECT ', [' + cp.name + ']' FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc2 JOIN sys.columns cp ON cp.object_id = fkc2.parent_object_id AND cp.column_id = fkc2.parent_column_id WHERE fkc2.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id ORDER BY fkc2.constraint_column_id FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') + ') REFERENCES [' + rs.name + '].[' + rt.name + '] (' + STUFF((SELECT ', [' + cr.name + ']' FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc3 JOIN sys.columns cr ON cr.object_id = fkc3.referenced_object_id AND cr.column_id = fkc3.referenced_column_id WHERE fkc3.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id ORDER BY fkc3.constraint_column_id FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') + ')' + CASE fk.delete_referential_action WHEN 1 THEN ' ON DELETE CASCADE' WHEN 2 THEN ' ON DELETE SET NULL' WHEN 3 THEN ' ON DELETE SET DEFAULT' ELSE '' END + CASE fk.update_referential_action WHEN 1 THEN ' ON UPDATE CASCADE' WHEN 2 THEN ' ON UPDATE SET NULL' WHEN 3 THEN ' ON UPDATE SET DEFAULT' ELSE '' END FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id = rt.schema_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id = t.object_id ORDER BY fk.name FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '')), '') + ')' AS ddl FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id WHERE s.name = '{esquema}' AND t.name = '{tabla}'
sqlserver.create_view: SELECT OBJECT_DEFINITION(v.object_id) AS ddl FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = v.schema_id WHERE s.name = '{esquema}' AND v.name = '{tabla}'
sqlserver.columnas_tabla: SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE, CASE WHEN c.IS_NULLABLE = 'YES' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS IS_NULLABLE, COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(CONCAT('{database}','.dbo.{tabla}')), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS is_identity, c.COLUMN_DEFAULT, c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, c.NUMERIC_PRECISION, c.NUMERIC_SCALE, ISNULL(CAST(ep.value AS VARCHAR(500)), '') AS column_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c LEFT JOIN sys.tables t ON t.name = '{tabla}' LEFT JOIN sys.columns sc ON sc.object_id = t.object_id AND sc.name = c.COLUMN_NAME LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.major_id = t.object_id AND ep.minor_id = sc.column_id AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND c.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY c.ORDINAL_POSITION
sqlserver.indices: SELECT i.name AS INDEX_NAME, c.name AS COLUMN_NAME, CASE WHEN i.is_unique = 1 THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness, i.type_desc AS index_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.indexes i ON t.object_id = i.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON i.object_id = ic.object_id AND i.index_id = ic.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON t.object_id = c.object_id AND ic.column_id = c.column_id WHERE t.schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('{database}') AND t.name = '{tabla}' AND i.name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.name, ic.key_ordinal
sqlserver.claves_primarias: SELECT kcu.COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND tc.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION
sqlserver.claves_foraneas: SELECT fk.name AS constraint_name, kcu.COLUMN_NAME AS child_column_name, pt.name AS parent_table_name, pc.name AS parent_column_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND rc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fk.name = rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fk.object_id = fkc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON fkc.referenced_object_id = pt.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON fkc.referenced_object_id = pc.object_id AND fkc.referenced_column_id = pc.column_id WHERE rc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND kcu.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY fk.name, kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION
sqlserver.claves_unicas: SELECT tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, kcu.COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' AND tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND tc.TABLE_NAME = '{tabla}' ORDER BY tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION
sqlserver.obtener_rutinas: SELECT ROUTINE_NAME AS routine_name, UPPER(ROUTINE_TYPE) AS routine_type, ISNULL(CAST(OBJECTPROPERTYEX(OBJECT_ID(CONCAT('[', ROUTINE_SCHEMA, '].[', ROUTINE_NAME, ']')), 'MS_Description') AS VARCHAR(500)), '') AS routine_comment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA = '{database}' ORDER BY ROUTINE_TYPE, ROUTINE_NAME
sqlserver.parametros_rutina: SELECT COALESCE(p.PARAMETER_MODE, '') AS parameter_mode, COALESCE(p.PARAMETER_NAME, '') AS parameter_name, COALESCE(p.DATA_TYPE, '') AS data_type, COALESCE(CAST(p.PARAMETER_DEFAULT AS VARCHAR(500)), '') AS parameter_default, p.ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS p JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES r ON r.SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = p.SPECIFIC_SCHEMA AND r.SPECIFIC_NAME = p.SPECIFIC_NAME WHERE p.SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = '{database}' AND r.ROUTINE_NAME = '{rutina}' AND UPPER(r.ROUTINE_TYPE) = UPPER('{tipo_rutina}') ORDER BY p.ORDINAL_POSITION
sqlserver.ficheros_fisicos: SELECT DB_NAME() AS [database_name], df.name AS [logical_name], df.type_desc AS [file_type], df.physical_name AS [physical_file], CAST(df.size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 AS [size_mb], CASE df.max_size WHEN -1 THEN NULL WHEN 0 THEN CAST(df.size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 ELSE CAST(df.max_size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 END AS [max_size_mb], df.is_percent_growth AS [is_percent_growth], CASE df.is_percent_growth WHEN 1 THEN CONCAT(df.growth, ' %') ELSE CONCAT(CAST(df.growth AS bigint) * 8 / 1024, ' MB') END AS [growth_setting] FROM sys.database_files AS df ORDER BY df.type_desc, [size_mb] DESC
sqlserver.temp_tablespaces: SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS [database_name], name AS [logical_name], type_desc AS [file_type], physical_name AS [physical_file], CAST(size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 AS [size_mb], CASE max_size WHEN -1 THEN NULL WHEN 0 THEN CAST(size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 ELSE CAST(max_size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 END AS [max_size_mb], is_percent_growth AS [is_percent_growth], CASE is_percent_growth WHEN 1 THEN CONCAT(growth, ' %') ELSE CONCAT(CAST(growth AS bigint) * 8 / 1024, ' MB') END AS [growth_setting] FROM sys.master_files WHERE DB_NAME(database_id) = 'tempdb' ORDER BY [file_type], [size_mb] DESC
sqlserver.columns_charset_collation: SELECT c.name AS column_name, NULL AS charset, c.collation_name AS collation FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.tables t ON c.object_id = t.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id WHERE s.name = '{database}' AND t.name = '{tabla}' AND c.collation_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.column_id

sqlite.obtener_tablas: SELECT name AS table_name, '' AS table_comment FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name
sqlite.obtener_vistas: SELECT name AS table_name, '' AS table_comment FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' ORDER BY name
sqlite.create_table: SELECT sql AS ddl FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='{tabla}'
sqlite.create_view: SELECT sql AS ddl FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' AND name='{tabla}'
sqlite.columnas_tabla: SELECT name AS column_name, type AS data_type, CASE WHEN "notnull" = 1 THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS nullable_flag, dflt_value AS column_default, '' AS character_maximum_length, '' AS numeric_precision, '' AS numeric_scale, '' AS column_comment, cid AS column_order, pk AS pk_order FROM pragma_table_info('{tabla}') ORDER BY cid
sqlite.indices: SELECT il.name AS index_name, ii.name AS column_name, CASE WHEN il."unique" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_unique, CASE il.origin WHEN 'pk' THEN 'PRIMARY KEY' WHEN 'u' THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'INDEX' END AS index_type FROM pragma_index_list('{tabla}') il JOIN pragma_index_info(il.name) ii ON 1=1 ORDER BY il.name, ii.seqno
sqlite.claves_primarias: SELECT name AS column_name FROM pragma_table_info('{tabla}') WHERE pk > 0 ORDER BY pk
sqlite.claves_foraneas: SELECT ('FK_' || '{tabla}' || '_' || id) AS constraint_name, "from" AS child_column_name, "table" AS parent_table_name, "to" AS parent_column_name FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('{tabla}') ORDER BY id, seq
sqlite.claves_unicas: SELECT il.name AS constraint_name, ii.name AS column_name FROM pragma_index_list('{tabla}') il JOIN pragma_index_info(il.name) ii ON 1=1 WHERE il."unique" = 1 AND il.origin <> 'pk' ORDER BY il.name, ii.seqno
sqlite.obtener_rutinas: SELECT '' AS routine_name, '' AS routine_type, '' AS routine_comment WHERE 1=0
sqlite.parametros_rutina: SELECT '' AS parameter_mode, '' AS parameter_name, '' AS data_type, '' AS parameter_default, 0 AS ordinal_position WHERE 1=0
sqlite.ficheros_fisicos_adicional: SELECT (SELECT page_count FROM pragma_page_count) AS page_count, (SELECT page_size FROM pragma_page_size) AS page_size, ((SELECT page_count FROM pragma_page_count) * (SELECT page_size FROM pragma_page_size)) AS size_bytes
sqlite.columns_charset_collation: SELECT '' AS column_name, '' AS charset, '' AS collation WHERE 1=0
